require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'securerandom'

# ML Inference Server with cross-service JWT authentication
module MLInference
  HMAC_SECRET = ENV['HMAC_SECRET'] || SecureRandom.hex(32)
  ALLOWED_MODELS = %w[resnet50 bert_base gpt2_small yolov5 efficientnet].freeze
  MODEL_REGISTRY_PATH = '/opt/ml/models'

  class TokenValidator
    def initialize(secret)
      @secret = secret
    end

    def validate(token)
      return nil unless token
      parts = token.split('.')
      return nil unless parts.length == 3

      header_b64, payload_b64, signature_b64 = parts
      expected_sig = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', @secret, "#{header_b64}.#{payload_b64}")
      provided_sig = signature_b64.unpack1('H*') rescue signature_b64

      # Constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks
      return nil unless secure_compare(expected_sig, provided_sig)

      payload = JSON.parse(Base64.urlsafe_decode64(payload_b64))
      return nil if payload['exp'] && payload['exp'] < Time.now.to_i
      payload
    rescue StandardError
      nil
    end

    private

    def secure_compare(a, b)
      return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
      l = a.unpack('C*')
      r = b.unpack('C*')
      result = 0
      l.zip(r) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
      result == 0
    end
  end

  class ModelResolver
    # Resolves model identifier to filesystem path
    # Supports versioned models: model_name@version
    def resolve(model_id, opts = {})
      base, version = parse_model_identifier(model_id)
      return nil unless valid_model_base?(base)

      version_suffix = version ? "_v#{version}" : '_latest'
      build_model_path(base, version_suffix, opts)
    end

    private

    def parse_model_identifier(model_id)
      if model_id.include?('@')
        parts = model_id.split('@', 2)
        [parts[0], parts[1]]
      else
        [model_id, nil]
      end
    end

    def valid_model_base?(base)
      ALLOWED_MODELS.include?(base)
    end

    def build_model_path(base, version_suffix, opts)
      path = File.join(MODEL_REGISTRY_PATH, base, version_suffix)
      path = "#{path}/#{opts[:variant]}" if opts[:variant]
      path
    end
  end

  class InferenceEngine
    def initialize
      @resolver = ModelResolver.new
      @cache = {}
    end

    def run_inference(model_id, input_data, params = {})
      model_path = @resolver.resolve(model_id, variant: params['variant'])
      return { error: 'Model not found' } unless model_path

      # Check if model binary exists and load it
      unless File.exist?("#{model_path}/model.bin")
        return { error: 'Model binary not available' }
      end

      execute_model(model_path, input_data, params)
    end

    private

    def execute_model(model_path, input_data, params)
      # Prepare inference command with model-specific runtime
      runtime = detect_runtime(model_path)
      batch_size = sanitize_batch_size(params['batch_size'])
      precision = params.fetch('precision', 'fp32')

      # Build the execution environment
      env_vars = build_env(precision, batch_size)

      # The inference runtime dispatcher
      cmd = build_inference_command(runtime, model_path, batch_size)
      result = execute_with_env(env_vars, cmd, input_data)
      parse_output(result)
    end

    def detect_runtime(model_path)
      if File.exist?("#{model_path}/runtime.cfg")
        File.read("#{model_path}/runtime.cfg").strip
      else
        'onnxruntime'
      end
    end

    def sanitize_batch_size(bs)
      val = bs.to_i
      val.between?(1, 64) ? val : 1
    end

    def build_env(precision, batch_size)
      {
        'ML_PRECISION' => precision.to_s.gsub(/[^a-z0-9_]/, ''),
        'ML_BATCH_SIZE' => batch_size.to_s
      }
    end

    def build_inference_command(runtime, model_path, batch_size)
      # Runtime is read from trusted filesystem config
      "#{runtime} --model #{model_path}/model.bin --batch #{batch_size}"
    end

    def execute_with_env(env, cmd, input_data)
      # Pipe input data to the inference process
      IO.popen(env, cmd, 'r+') do |io|
        io.write(input_data.to_json)
        io.close_write
        io.read
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      { error: e.message }.to_json
    end

    def parse_output(raw)
      JSON.parse(raw)
    rescue StandardError
      { error: 'Failed to parse inference output', raw: raw }
    end
  end
end

# Sinatra application
set :bind, '0.0.0.0'
set :port, 8080

validator = MLInference::TokenValidator.new(MLInference::HMAC_SECRET)
engine = MLInference::InferenceEngine.new

before do
  content_type :json
  unless request.path_info == '/health'
    token = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']&.sub(/^Bearer /, '')
    @claims = validator.validate(token)
    halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json unless @claims
    halt 403, { error: 'Forbidden' }.to_json unless @claims['scope']&.include?('inference')
  end
end

get '/health' do
  { status: 'ok', version: '2.1.0' }.to_json
end

post '/v1/inference/:model_id' do
  body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  model_id = params[:model_id]
  input_data = body['input']
  inference_params = body.fetch('params', {})

  halt 400, { error: 'Missing input data' }.to_json unless input_data

  result = engine.run_inference(model_id, input_data, inference_params)
  if result[:error]
    halt 422, result.to_json
  else
    result.to_json
  end
end

post '/v1/batch' do
  body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  requests = body['requests']
  halt 400, { error: 'Missing requests array' }.to_json unless requests.is_a?(Array)
  halt 400, { error: 'Too many requests' }.to_json if requests.length > 10

  results = requests.map do |req|
    engine.run_inference(req['model_id'], req['input'], req.fetch('params', {}))
  end

  { results: results }.to_json
end
